data.weapons.description.needle: Rapidly fires thin shots, wearing down approaching enemies one at a time.
data.weapons.branch.needle.description.s: Each shot spreads in three directions, adding one shot to each side. Spread shots have no additional piercing.
data.weapons.branch.needle.description.p: Adds 2 to the pierce count, 18% to projectile speed, and 12% to power.
Increases each shot's power by 22% to wear down tough enemies.
data.weapons.branch.needle.description.t: Shortens the firing interval by 18%, keeping fire on shields and small enemies.
data.weapons.evolution.description.needl: Adds one follow-up volley to the left and right immediately after the main shot. Follow-up shots do not generate further follow-ups.
data.weapons.description.ray: Cuts along the aimed line in one strike, reaching enemies lined up along it.
data.weapons.branch.ray.description.wide: Widens the beam by 20 and extends its visible duration from 0.16 to 0.22 seconds.
data.weapons.branch.ray.description.refl: If the beam reaches the boundary before its range ends, returns one beam in the opposite direction from the boundary at 55% power.
data.weapons.branch.ray.description.powe: Increases each beam's power by 22% to cut through tough enemy lines.
data.weapons.branch.ray.description.temp: Shortens the firing interval by 18% to repeat straight-line attacks more often.
data.weapons.evolution.description.ray-c: Adds one short perpendicular beam at 72% length and 45% power at the same time as the main beam.
data.weapons.description.cluster: Telegraphs an attack toward a crowded direction and strikes the area around the impact point.
After impact, sends smaller shots in three directions at 30% of the original power; each makes one further small-area attack.
Leaves a slowing zone at the impact point for 1.8 seconds. A Brake Ring extends only the slow duration.
Increases impact power by 22% to break up dense enemy groups.
Shortens the firing interval by 18% to repeat area attacks toward danger.
data.weapons.evolution.description.clust: After impact, sends small area shots in three directions once, at 32% of the original power. Splitting-type smaller shots do not generate more.
data.weapons.description.repulse: Spreads a shockwave around the core, pushing nearby enemies back.
Multiplies pushback distance by 1.5 and increases shockwave power by 25%.
Extends the slow on pushed enemies from 0.4 to 1.4 seconds.
Increases shockwave power by 22% to break up enemies near the core.
Shortens the firing interval by 18% to reduce gaps in defense.
data.weapons.evolution.description.repul: Adds one non-damaging slow wave lasting 0.6 seconds outside the normal area (radius +58).
data.weapons.description.chain: Passes the attack from the first enemy to nearby enemies, wearing down dense groups.
data.weapons.branch.chain.description.ch: Increases the chain limit from 3 to 5 enemies. Each next enemy is selected within 150 of the previous one.
data.weapons.branch.chain.description.bu: After the chain hits at least 1 enemy, makes one area attack at its final position with radius 40 and 50% power.
data.weapons.branch.chain.description.po: Increases each chain hit's power by 22% to damage deeper into groups.
data.weapons.branch.chain.description.te: Shortens the firing interval by 18% to reach new groups sooner.
data.weapons.evolution.description.chain: Adds 2 more enemies to the chain limit. Each link is within 150 of the previous enemy; it does not start a separate chain.
data.weapons.description.orbit: Blades orbit the core and damage approaching enemies on contact.
data.weapons.branch.orbit.description.ma: Adds 1 blade and increases rotation speed by 25%.
data.weapons.branch.orbit.description.ou: Increases orbit radius by 38 and blade length by 28.
data.weapons.branch.orbit.description.po: Increases blade power by 22% for stronger damage to approaching enemies.
data.weapons.branch.orbit.description.te: Shortens the firing interval by 18% for more frequent hits around the core.
data.weapons.evolution.description.orbit: Adds one ring of blades at 60% power outside the normal orbit (radius +52). Its contact interval is checked separately from the inner ring.
data.weapons.description.disc: Fires discs that bounce off enemies and the boundary, repeatedly reaching multiple directions.
data.weapons.branch.disc.description.ech: Adds 3 bounces off enemies or the boundary and increases speed by 20%.
data.weapons.branch.disc.description.tra: While flying, leaves a small-area attack at its current position every 0.18 seconds, with radius 28 and 20% power.
data.weapons.branch.disc.description.pow: Increases disc power by 22%, strengthening each bouncing hit.
data.weapons.branch.disc.description.tem: Shortens the firing interval by 18% to keep multiple discs on the field.
data.weapons.evolution.description.disc-: Fires one smaller disc at a 60-degree offset with 45% power and 86% speed, at the same time as the main disc.
data.weapons.description.gravity: Creates a pulling point near the outer edge, gathering enemies and briefly restricting their movement.
Increases gravity-well duration by 40% and pulling radius by 20%.
When the gravity well disappears, makes one area attack in the same area at 180% of base power.
Increases gravity-well power by 22% to damage gathered enemies.
Shortens the firing interval by 18% to reduce time without control.
data.weapons.evolution.description.gravi: Adds one auxiliary gravity well at an angular offset from the main well, with 72% duration, 70% radius, and 45% power.
data.weapons.description.grid: Removes enemy projectiles in the selected direction while firing 1 low-power shot. It cannot protect outside the interception line.
data.weapons.branch.grid.description.nar: Narrows the grid by 8. Interception count and range do not change.
data.weapons.branch.grid.description.mul: Adds 1 to the number of enemy projectiles a single grid can remove. It does not add directions to the grid.
data.weapons.branch.grid.description.pow: Strengthens the short shot after interception, retaining some firepower even when no enemy projectiles are present.
data.weapons.branch.grid.description.tem: Shortens reload time by 18% to bring the grid back for dangerous waves.
data.weapons.evolution.description.grid-: Adds a perpendicular interception line alongside the selected direction, with 70% width and 72% range. Both directions share the interception limit.
data.weapons.description.mine: Places time-limited mines in the enemy path; they explode over an area when enemies pass.
data.weapons.branch.mine.description.nea: Places mines at the shorter of the target distance and 260, protecting the area nearer the core first.
data.weapons.branch.mine.description.rem: Places mines 90 beyond the target, constrained to the weapon's range.
data.weapons.branch.mine.description.pow: Increases explosion-area power by 22% to damage shells in one blast.
data.weapons.branch.mine.description.tem: Shortens placement intervals by 18% to replace mines along open paths.
data.weapons.evolution.description.mine-: Places 3 mines in total: one along the aim and two at left/right angular offsets. Increases the held-mine limit by 1. Oldest mines are replaced first.
data.weapons.description.lance: Fires a heavy lance after each charge period, piercing enemies in a straight line. It does not bypass enemy shields or shells.
data.weapons.branch.lance.description.lo: Increases lance range by 18% and width by 4. Charge time and power do not change.
data.weapons.branch.lance.description.sh: Adds 2 to lance pierce count and increases power by 20%.
data.weapons.branch.lance.description.po: Increases heavy-strike power by 22% to wear down tough defenses.
data.weapons.branch.lance.description.te: Shortens reload time by 18% to reduce gaps between charges.
data.weapons.evolution.description.lance: Fires one second lance along the same aim at 48% power and 92% speed. The second lance does not generate more.
data.weapons.description.drone: Up to 2 drones orbit the placed weapon, each aiming and firing at enemies. The drones do not fly after enemies to their positions.
data.weapons.branch.drone.description.ne: Increases drone orbital speed by 25%. Range and orbit radius do not change.
data.weapons.branch.drone.description.re: Increases drone orbit radius by 35%. Projectile range does not change.
data.weapons.branch.drone.description.po: Increases drone projectile power by 22% to damage individual dangerous targets.
data.weapons.branch.drone.description.te: Shortens drone reload time by 18% to reduce gaps in tracking fire.
data.weapons.evolution.description.drone: Increases drone orbital speed by 12% and radius by 10%, with slightly offset starting positions. The number of drones does not increase.

data.supports.description.output: Adds to the base power of weapons connected on either side. Total bonus to the same weapon is capped at 40%.
data.supports.description.rhythm: Shortens the firing interval of weapons connected on either side. Total reduction is capped at 30%.
data.supports.description.branch: Counts connected-weapon firings and adds 1 shot at 50% power after a set number. Additional shots are not counted again.
data.supports.level1.label.branch: 1 additional shot at 50% power every 6 firings
data.supports.level2.label.branch: 1 additional shot at 50% power every 5 firings
data.supports.level3.label.branch: 1 additional shot at 50% power every 4 firings
data.supports.description.focus: Separately increases connected-weapon range and projectile speed. Bonuses stack up to 35% range and 44% speed.
data.supports.description.observe: Increases power against Shells, Markers, Droppers, Phase units, Guards, and bosses.
data.supports.description.brake: Extends Repulsion Ring pushback distance and slow duration from gravity wells and residual zones. It does not affect other attacks.
data.supports.description.relay: In addition to weapons on either side, from layer 2 onward relays output once to the weapon one layer inward in the same direction. Relays do not loop.
data.supports.description.repair: Heals the core when a connected Interception Grid removes an enemy projectile or an Orbital Mine explodes.
data.supports.description.shatter: On hitting a Lattice or Guard shield, removes 1 extra shield layer in addition to the normal hit and increases power. It does not affect Shells.
data.supports.role.shatter: Extra shattering of Lattice / Guard shields
data.supports.level1.label.shatter: Power against shields +12% / 1 extra shield layer shattered per hit
data.supports.level2.label.shatter: Power against shields +20% / 1 extra shield layer shattered per hit
data.supports.level3.label.shatter: Power against shields +30% / 1 extra shield layer shattered per hit
data.supports.description.conductive: Hitting a slowed enemy passes a brief slow to other nearby enemies. It does not pass marks or burning.
data.supports.description.ignite: Defeating a marked or burning enemy creates one nearby area explosion based on the current power of the first weapon in the build. A weapon connection is not required.
data.supports.level1.label.ignite: On defeat: 6.6% of the current power of the first weapon in the build / Radius 34
data.supports.level2.label.ignite: On defeat: 9.9% of the current power of the first weapon in the build / Radius 42
data.supports.level3.label.ignite: On defeat: 14.3% of the current power of the first weapon in the build / Radius 52
data.supports.description.brink: Increases power for all placed weapons only while core durability is at or below 30% of maximum. It does not stop barrier recovery.
data.supports.level1.label.brink: Power +6% while core is at or below 30%
data.supports.level2.label.brink: Power +10% while core is at or below 30%
data.supports.level3.label.brink: Power +18% while core is at or below 30%
data.supports.description.anchor: Extends the duration of gravity wells, Orbital Mines, and Tracking Drones. It affects duration only, not their spawn positions.
data.supports.description.veil: Always reduces contact and projectile damage to the core. Connected-weapon power decreases by the same percentage.
data.supports.description.vector: Increases connected-weapon power only during manual aiming. It has no effect during automatic aiming.
data.supports.description.pulse: On a cycle separate from normal firing, selects the earliest connected weapon in build order and emits a small auxiliary wave around its target.
data.supports.description.reserve: Slightly shortens the Charged Lance's refire interval. It does not change other weapons' charge or discharge behavior.
data.supports.level1.label.reserve: Charged Lance refire interval shortened by up to 0.08 seconds
data.supports.level2.label.reserve: Charged Lance refire interval shortened by up to 0.16 seconds
data.supports.level3.label.reserve: Charged Lance refire interval shortened by up to 0.24 seconds
data.supports.description.lattice: Increases how many enemy projectiles an Interception Grid can remove per firing, up to 4.
data.supports.description.orbit: Widens Orbiting Blade radius and slightly speeds up rotation. It does not affect shuttle shots or other movement paths.
data.supports.description.catalyst: Adds power when hitting slowed Markers, Phase units, or bosses without consuming the status. It does not affect other enemies.
data.supports.level1.label.catalyst: Power against slowed Markers / Phase units / bosses +10%
data.supports.level2.label.catalyst: Power against slowed Markers / Phase units / bosses +16%
data.supports.level3.label.catalyst: Power against slowed Markers / Phase units / bosses +24%
data.synergyTags.description.power: Works well with Output Ring, Relay Ring, Last Stand Ring, Direction Ring
data.synergyTags.description.speed: Works well with Rhythm Ring, Branch Ring
data.synergyTags.description.target: Works well with Observation Ring, Catalyst Ring
data.synergyTags.description.control: Works well with Brake Ring, Conductive Ring
data.synergyTags.description.shield: Works well with Shatter Ring, Lattice Ring
data.synergyTags.description.status: Works well with Detonation Ring, Conductive Ring, Catalyst Ring
data.synergyTags.description.defense: Works well with Maintenance Ring, Veil Ring, Lattice Ring
data.synergyTags.description.area: Works well with Pulse Ring, Detonation Ring
data.stages.description.stage-1: Your first defense: learn basic aiming, upgrades, and the Rotating Crown.
data.stages.description.stage-2: Match weapon roles to combinations of Shells and Markers.
data.stages.description.stage-3: Face every enemy type and the Echo Core to complete your assembled device.
data.stages.description.stage-4: Switch between intercepting projectiles and dealing with shooters; read crossing telegraph lines.
data.stages.description.stage-5: Stop Repair units and Factories first to break their finite support network.
data.stages.description.stage-6: A mixed battle for a complete build, with charging, ranged, and support enemies appearing together.
data.stages.description.endless: A record challenge with no time limit; danger increases every 5 minutes.
data.enemies.description.runner: A slender enemy that approaches quickly.
data.enemies.description.shell: Has a thick ring that caps damage from a single hit at 24.
data.enemies.description.lattice: Its body takes no damage until it has received 8 attacks.
data.enemies.description.spore: Splits into 2 small enemies once when defeated.
data.enemies.description.dropper: Stops away from the core and fires a projectile after a warning.
data.enemies.description.phase: Periodically becomes briefly immune to attacks.
data.enemies.description.charger: Stops and telegraphs before a short charge, leaving an opening afterward.
data.enemies.description.guard: Projects a shield across a limited forward angle to protect nearby enemies.
data.enemies.description.repair: Heals nearby enemies a small amount after a warning.
data.enemies.description.factory: Periodically creates small summoned units. These offspring give no rewards.
data.bosses.description.crown: Three shields rotate; only attacks through their gaps reach the body.
data.bosses.description.designer: A boss that gathers and sends small enemies in one direction. Watch the telegraph line and meet the attack.
data.bosses.description.echo: Prepares reflected projectiles when attacked. Check their telegraphed directions.
data.bosses.description.gate: Alternates telegraphed fire in two directions, creating openings to stop its launchers.
data.bosses.description.weaver: Weaves a finite set of support nodes and sends waves with Repair units and Guards.
data.bosses.description.reactor: Switches among close-range, ranged, and support phases, forcing you to adapt.
data.research.description.core-health: Increases maximum core durability by 5 per level.
data.research.description.part-yield: Increases parts earned from results by 5% per level.
data.research.description.weapon-power: Increases base power of all weapons by 3% per level.
data.research.description.projectile-spe: Increases projectile-weapon speed by 5% per level.
data.research.description.candidate-deta: Shows base attack power and the resulting role on upgrade candidates.
data.research.description.enemy-records: Shows descriptions and defeat counts for enemies encountered.
data.research.description.weapon-records: Shows the highest damage dealt by each weapon.
data.research.description.sector-records: Shows damage received by direction for each stage.
